purpose: Distinguish output-format failure from node-choice failure using existing frozen weights.

variants.name: strict_system
variants.system_suffix: Respond with exactly one decimal node ID and nothing else. Do not explain, analyze, restate the task, or list multiple nodes. Give the answer immediately.

grammar: Greedy prefix constraint over tokenizer encodings of every ID 0..31 followed by native EOS; no adjacency, distance, legal-action filtering, or answer labels enter decoding.
interpretation: Post-hoc diagnostic on the previously inspected test split; separate from original free-generation results, not a new confirmatory test. No model or checkpoint selection.
